spinach.name: Baby Spinach
spinach.tagline: Plant-Based Non-Heme Iron & Bone Calcium Density
spinach.bioavailabilityNote: Pairing non-heme iron in spinach with Vitamin C (e.g., lemon juice or bell peppers) increases iron absorption efficiency by up to 300%.

dishes.title: Palak Paneer (Creamy Spinach Curry)
steps: Blanch spinach leaves in boiling water for 2 mins, then submerge in ice water to maintain vibrant green color.
Puree blanched spinach with 1 green chili.
Sauté diced onions, ginger, and garlic until golden. Add cumin, coriander, and garam masala.
Stir in spinach puree and golden paneer cubes. Simmer for 5 mins and finish with cream.

dishes.title: Garlic Sautéed Spinach & Toasted Pine Nuts
steps: Toast pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden brown (approx 2 mins); set aside.
Heat olive oil in skillet and sauté sliced garlic until fragrant (don't burn!).
Add fresh spinach in batches, tossing gently until just wilted (approx 3 mins).
Remove from heat, squeeze fresh lemon juice, and top with toasted pine nuts.

dishes.title: Greek Spanakopita Spinach Bites
steps: Squeeze all excess moisture from cooked spinach.
Mix spinach with feta, beaten egg, dill, and black pepper.
Cut phyllo dough into strips, brush with melted butter, and fold spinach filling into triangles.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 20 mins until golden and crispy.

bell_pepper.name: Red Bell Pepper
bell_pepper.tagline: Cellular Antioxidant & High-Dose Vitamin C Defense
bell_pepper.bioavailabilityNote: Red bell peppers deliver over 140% of daily Vitamin C requirements. Eating them raw preserves heat-sensitive L-ascorbic acid.

dishes.title: Quinoa & Black Bean Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Pre-bake halved peppers cut side up for 10 mins at 190°C.
Mix cooked quinoa, rinsed black beans, corn, cumin, chili powder, and salsa.
Stuff pepper halves generously with quinoa filling.
Top with cheese and bake for 20 mins until cheese bubbles.

dishes.title: Sizzling Triple-Pepper Fajita Skillet
steps: Heat cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add 2 tbsp oil, then toss in sliced peppers and onions.
Sauté vigorously for 6-8 mins until charred yet crisp-tender.
Sprinkle fajita seasoning, squeeze lime juice, and serve.

dishes.title: Smoky Spanish Roasted Red Pepper Romesco
steps: Pulse toasted almonds and garlic in a food processor until finely ground.
Add roasted red peppers, sherry vinegar, smoked paprika, and salt.
Stream in olive oil while blending until sauce reaches a rustic paste consistency.
Serve alongside grilled vegetables or crusty bread.

carrot.name: Heirloom Orange Carrot
carrot.bioavailabilityNote: Beta-carotene is fat-soluble. Roasting carrots with healthy oils (olive oil or avocado) increases carotenoid bioavailability by up to 650%.

dishes.title: Moroccan Honey Glazed Carrots with Cumin
steps: Toss cut carrots with olive oil, honey, ground cumin, sea salt, and black pepper.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 25 mins until tender and caramelized around the edges.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

dishes.title: Silky Carrot Ginger & Coconut Soup
steps: Sauté ginger and onions in a pot until soft.
Add chopped carrots and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 mins until carrots are soft.
Pour in coconut milk and blend until silky smooth using an immersion blender.
Finish with a squeeze of fresh lime juice and chili flakes.

dishes.title: Crispy Ribbon Carrot & Chickpea Salad
steps: Use a vegetable peeler to shave carrots into long, thin ribbons.
Combine carrot ribbons, rinsed chickpeas, and toasted pumpkin seeds in a large bowl.
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and water for dressing.
Toss salad gently with dressing right before serving.

broccoli.name: Crown Broccoli
broccoli.tagline: Sulforaphane Phytochemicals & Phase II Enzyme Activation
broccoli.bioavailabilityNote: Cutting broccoli and waiting 10 minutes before cooking activates myrosinase enzymes, maximizing anticarcinogenic sulforaphane formation.

dishes.title: Charred Garlic Broccoli with Lemon & Parmesan
steps: Toss florets with olive oil, minced garlic, sea salt, and black pepper.
Roast at 220°C (425°F) for 15 mins until edges are crispy and charred.
Remove from oven, toss with fresh lemon zest, juice, and grated parmesan.

dishes.title: Velvety Broccoli & Aged Cheddar Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in butter. Add flour to form a roux.
Whisk in milk and stock; bring to boil until thickened.
Add chopped broccoli florets and simmer for 10 mins until tender.
Stir in shredded sharp cheddar off the heat until melted and velvety.

dishes.title: Ginger Garlic Broccoli Stir-Fry with Sesame
steps: Blanch broccoli florets for 1 min in boiling water, then drain.
Heat sesame oil in wok over high heat; sauté ginger and garlic for 30s.
Add broccoli florets and stir-fry for 3 mins.
Pour soy sauce glaze; toss to coat and sprinkle sesame seeds.

tomato.name: Vine-Ripe Tomato
tomato.bioavailabilityNote: Cooking tomatoes breaks down cell walls, making lycopene (a powerful antioxidant for cardiovascular health) 4x more bioavailable than raw.

dishes.title: Herbed Shakshuka with Poached Eggs
steps: Dice tomatoes and onions finely.
Sauté onions in olive oil until translucent, then add spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer until a thick sauce forms (approx 10 mins).
Crack eggs into sauce wells. Cover and simmer for 5-7 mins until set.

dishes.title: Caprese Salad with Aged Balsamic
steps: Alternate slices of tomato, mozzarella, and fresh basil leaves on a platter.
Drizzle with high-quality extra virgin olive oil.
Finish with a swirl of aged balsamic reduction and sea salt flakes.

dishes.title: Roasted Garlic & Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Roast halved tomatoes and garlic bulb at 200°C for 25 mins until caramelized.
Blend roast tomatoes, garlic, fresh basil, and warm broth until silky smooth.
Season with cracked black pepper and olive oil drizzle.

avocado.name: Hass Avocado
avocado.bioavailabilityNote: Adding avocado to salads enhances fat-soluble carotenoid (lutein, zeaxanthin, beta-carotene) absorption from other veggies by 400-1500%.

dishes.title: Authentic Chunky Guacamole with Lime
steps: Halve avocados, remove pit, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash coarsely with a fork, leaving chunky pieces.
Fold in diced red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, and sea salt.

dishes.title: Artisanal Sourdough Avocado Toast
steps: Toast thick sourdough slices until golden.
Smash ripe avocado with lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper.
Spread generously over sourdough, top with radish slices and hemp seeds.

dishes.title: Green Goddess Creamy Avocado Dressing
steps: Combine avocado, Greek yogurt, fresh herbs, garlic, lemon juice, and water in blender.
Blend until silky smooth and emerald green.
Serve as salad dressing or vegetable dip.

beetroot.name: Dark Red Beetroot
beetroot.tagline: Inorganic Nitrates & Nitric Oxide Endothelial Vasodilation
beetroot.bioavailabilityNote: Dietary nitrates in beetroot convert to nitric oxide in the bloodstream, improving arterial compliance and lowering blood pressure.

dishes.title: Roasted Beetroot & Goat Cheese Salad
steps: Wrap beets in foil and roast at 200°C for 45 mins until tender.
Slice roasted beets into wedges.
Arrange bed of arugula, top with beets, goat cheese, and toasted walnuts.
Drizzle with honey mustard vinaigrette.

dishes.title: Traditional Ukrainian Beetroot Borscht
steps: Sauté grated beets and carrots with tomato paste in olive oil for 10 mins.
Boil potatoes and cabbage in vegetable broth for 15 mins.
Combine beet mixture into soup pot and simmer for 10 mins.
Serve with fresh sour cream and dill.

dishes.title: Artisanal Beetroot & Tahini Hummus
steps: Combine roasted beet, drained chickpeas, tahini, garlic, and lemon juice in blender.
Blend while pouring olive oil until ultra-creamy.
Garnish with sesame seeds and microgreens.

sweet_potato.name: Orange Sweet Potato
sweet_potato.bioavailabilityNote: Boiling sweet potatoes retains more beta-carotene and results in a lower glycemic index compared to high-heat roasting.

dishes.title: Crispy Baked Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Cut sweet potatoes into uniform wedges.
Toss with cornstarch first, then coat with olive oil and spices.
Spread on baking tray leaving space between wedges.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 25 mins, flipping halfway.

dishes.title: Black Bean & Avocado Stuffed Sweet Potato
steps: Roast sweet potatoes whole at 200°C for 45 mins until soft.
Slice down middle and fluff interior with a fork.
Stuff with warm seasoned black beans, avocado, and cilantro dressing.

dishes.title: Coconut Sweet Potato & Chickpea Curry
steps: Sauté yellow curry paste in oil until fragrant.
Add sweet potato, chickpeas, and coconut milk; simmer for 20 mins until tender.
Stir in fresh spinach leaves until wilted.
Serve hot over steamed jasmine rice.

pumpkin.name: Sugar Pumpkin
pumpkin.bioavailabilityNote: Pumpkin seeds (pepitas) are exceptionally dense in bioavailable magnesium and zinc—don't discard them when roasting!

dishes.title: Roasted Pumpkin & Sage Risotto
steps: Roast cubed pumpkin at 200°C for 20 mins; mash half.
Sauté shallots in butter, add Arborio rice, and toast for 2 mins.
Add warm stock 1 ladle at a time until absorbed.
Fold in mashed pumpkin, parmesan, and fried crisp sage leaves.

dishes.title: Thai Red Curry Pumpkin & Coconut Soup
steps: Fry red curry paste in coconut milk until aromatic.
Add pumpkin puree, coconut milk, and stock; bring to boil.
Simmer for 15 mins. Season with lime juice and soy sauce.
Serve with fresh cilantro and toasted pumpkin seeds.

dishes.title: Rustic Pumpkin & Feta Tart
steps: Roll out puff pastry on baking tray.
Spread caramelized onions over pastry, leaving border.
Layer thinly sliced pumpkin, crumble feta, and scatter thyme.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 mins until pastry is golden brown.

mushroom.name: Cremini Mushroom
mushroom.tagline: Natural Ergocalciferol Vitamin D & Glutamate Umami
mushroom.bioavailabilityNote: Exposing mushrooms to sunlight or UV light for 15 minutes before cooking converts ergosterol into Vitamin D2, boosting Vitamin D density by over 400%.

dishes.title: Pan-Seared Garlic Butter Cremini Mushrooms
steps: Heat dry skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms without crowding.
Sear undisturbed for 4 mins until deep golden brown.
Add butter, minced garlic, thyme, and salt; toss for 3 mins.
Deglaze pan with a splash of white wine or broth.

dishes.title: Wild Mushroom & Truffle Oil Risotto
steps: Sauté wild mushrooms in olive oil until golden; set half aside.
Prepare risotto base by toasting rice with shallots, adding stock gradually.
Fold cooked mushrooms and parmesan into finished risotto.
Drizzle with truffle oil before serving.

dishes.title: Balsamic Marinated Portobello Burger
steps: Marinate portobello caps in balsamic vinegar, olive oil, and garlic for 10 mins.
Grill or pan-fry caps for 5 mins per side until tender.
Top with swiss cheese during last minute to melt.
Serve inside toasted brioche buns with arugula and aioli.

zucchini.name: Courgette Zucchini
zucchini.bioavailabilityNote: Zucchini skin contains the highest concentration of lutein and zeaxanthin (antioxidants protecting macular vision)—never peel before cooking.

dishes.title: Zucchini Noodles (Zoodles) with Fresh Pesto
steps: Spiralize zucchini into long noodles.
Sauté zoodles in 1 tsp olive oil for just 2 mins (don't overcook!).
Toss with fresh pesto and halved cherry tomatoes.
Top with parmesan and toasted pine nuts.

dishes.title: Crispy Zucchini & Herb Fritters
steps: Grate zucchini, toss with salt, and squeeze out excess liquid in a clean tea towel.
Mix squeezed zucchini with beaten egg, flour, dill, and green onions.
Drop spoonfuls onto hot oiled pan and flatten into patties.
Fry 4 mins per side until golden brown. Serve with tzatziki.

dishes.title: Charred Lemon Garlic Grilled Zucchini Planks
steps: Slice zucchini into long 1/4-inch planks.
Brush both sides with olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Grill on high heat for 3 mins per side for deep marks.
Drizzle with lemon juice and red pepper flakes.

cucumber.name: English Cucumber
cucumber.bioavailabilityNote: Cucumbers contain 95.2% structured cellular water with electrolytes (potassium & magnesium), providing superior hydration over plain water.

dishes.title: Authentic Village Greek Salad (Horiatiki)
steps: Cut cucumber and tomatoes into thick chunky wedges.
Combine in bowl with sliced red onion and Kalamata olives.
Place a whole slab of feta cheese on top.
Sprinkle dried oregano and pour extra virgin olive oil.

dishes.title: Smashed Asian Cucumber Salad with Chili Oil
steps: Smash cucumbers with a rolling pin or flat knife blade to fracture open.
Cut diagonally into bite-sized pieces.
Toss with soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, and crispy chili oil.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and cilantro.

dishes.title: Cool Greek Cucumber & Garlic Tzatziki
steps: Grate cucumber finely and squeeze thoroughly to remove water.
Mix squeezed cucumber into thick Greek yogurt.
Stir in crushed garlic, fresh dill, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Chill in fridge for 30 mins before serving.
